**Finding: missing (fallback cure proposed)**

The agreement has no exit or data-return mechanic anywhere. Section 17(b) runs entirely one way — Sparkling must cease use and certify destruction/return of Garman's Software, Documentation and Codes — while Sections 16 (escrow), 18 (survival) and 4 (installation-stage data conversion) contain nothing about transition help or return of Sparkling's own data. Targeted searches for transition, exit, export and data return produced no responsive clause.

I inserted a single new Section 17(d) at the fallback level: transition assistance on expiry or termination for at least 90 calendar days, plus export and delivery of all data belonging to, supplied by or processed for Sparkling within 30 calendar days. I kept the preferred six-month/then-current-rates and certified-deletion mechanics out to keep the change minimal, and used a descriptive data formulation because "Customer Data" is undefined in this agreement.
